international.title: Badenoch says using amputee athletes to justify cutting disability benefits was ‘message of hope’ – UK politics live
international.summary: PM has asked Badenoch to withdraw her suggestion that benefits should be cut because ‘double amputees run marathons’ Good morning. At PMQs yesterday Andy Burnham said that Kemi Badenoch should withdraw the “double amputees run marathons” comment that she used to justify the Tory plan to cut sickness and disability benefits by £14bn. It was “crass and insensitive” , he said. This morning Badenoch defended what she was saying claimed that, in fact, she was delivering a “message of hope”. I will speak the truth and I will say what I believe is common sense. And what I know is that, if people can work, then we should encourage them to work. And what I’m saying is actually a message of hope, that if people even with significant, problems can work, then those who have ADHD and mild anxiety should go to work. People are free to disagree, but they know where I’m coming from. I will post more from the interview shortly. Continue reading...
